description: This PHP script is designed to interact with the TestLink API to retrieve a test plan by name. It prepares request arguments, initializes an XML-RPC client, and executes the API call, also including some diagnostic and message functions.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: An object representing an XML-RPC client used for communicating with the TestLink API.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Function to execute an API call using the provided XML-RPC client, method name, and arguments.
